parsed.summary: Expect working capital cycle to trend towards 45 to 50 days
parsed.speaker: Aditya Nathany
parsed.quote: As these benefits gradually normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to trend towards our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.

parsed.summary: Confident of sustaining medium to long term EBITDA margins within 11% to 13%
parsed.speaker: Aditya Nathany
parsed.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium - to long -term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.

parsed.summary: Expect FMEG EBITDA margin to end up in 8% to 10% range over long term
parsed.speaker: Aditya Nathany
parsed.quote: So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.
